title: BLOOM-WILT: Logit Tilting for Behaviour Elicitation in Automated LLM Auditing
abstract: arXiv:2608.31105v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Users of a deployed language model routinely encounter behaviours that testing almost never surfaces, since deployment puts the model through orders of magnitude more interactions than any evaluation can simulate. Automated auditors make testing cheap to scale and flexible enough to cover almost any specified behaviour, yet their lack of optimisation pressure makes them sample-inefficient. To address this shortcoming, we introduce BLOOM-WILT, a full auditing pipeline that elicits natural multi-turn instances of rare behaviours, without training cost or access beyond the target's next-token distribution. On the input side, WILT's auditor model revises its conversational strategy across rounds, learning from previous scored interactions. On the output side, WILT adaptively reweights the target's decoding using the model's own distribution conditioned on an elicitation prompt, so that behaviour-relevant generations are sampled ahead of othe

translated_title: BLOOM-WILT：面向自动化大语言模型审计的行为诱导Logit倾斜方法
translated_abstract: 部署后的语言模型的用户经常会遇到测试几乎从未暴露出的行为，因为部署使模型经历的交互数量比任何评估所能模拟的都要高出几个数量级。自动化审计器使测试能够低成本地扩展规模，且足够灵活以覆盖几乎任何指定的行为，但由于缺乏优化压力，其采样效率低下。为了解决这一缺陷，我们提出了BLOOM-WILT，一个完整的审计流水线，它能够诱导出罕见行为的自然多轮对话实例，且无需训练成本，也不需要超出目标模型下一词元分布之外的访问权限。在输入侧，WILT的审计器模型在多轮交互中不断修订其对话策略，从之前已评分的交互中学习。在输出侧，WILT基于诱导提示，利用模型自身的分布自适应地对目标模型的解码进行重新加权，使得与行为相关的生成内容被优先采样，而其他生成内容则被抑制。（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: BLOOM-WILT提出了一种无需训练的完整LLM审计流水线，通过输入侧基于历史评分交互的多轮对话策略学习，以及输出侧利用目标模型自身分布进行自适应logit倾斜重加权解码，高效诱导出罕见行为，显著提升了自动化LLM审计的采样效率。
en_tdlr: BLOOM-WILT is a training-free automated LLM auditing pipeline that efficiently elicits rare behaviours through multi-turn conversational strategy learning on the input side and adaptive logit-tilted decoding reweighting on the output side, greatly improving sampling efficiency in LLM auditing.
